in_marathi.name: Gangadutt
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess Ganga's son
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gangadutt हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Gangadutt is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Ganga' meaning river and 'Dutt' meaning son. This name signifies the son of Goddess Ganga, who is revered in Hinduism. It is a popular name in Hindu communities and holds significant cultural and spiritual significance.
